shadows.name: temporary-lift
shadows.purpose: Temporary notices and active drag state only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height:44px; border:1px solid #160526; border-radius:0; padding:11px 17px; background:#ff5bd6; color:#160526; box-shadow:4px 4px 0 #160526; font:900 .8rem 'Aptos Narrow','Bahnschrift Condensed',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.045em; text-transform:uppercase; transition:transform .2s ease-out,box-shadow .2s ease-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover { transform:translate(2px,2px); box-shadow:2px 2px 0 #160526; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #160526; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height:44px; border:1px solid #160526; border-radius:0; padding:11px 17px; background:transparent; color:#160526; font:900 .8rem 'Aptos Narrow','Bahnschrift Condensed',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.045em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background:#160526; color:#fbf6ff; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #160526; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Time Input
components.css: .ds-input { width:150px; height:42px; border:1px solid #160526; border-radius:0; padding:7px 8px; background:#fffaff; color:#160526; font:800 .8rem 'Aptos Narrow','Bahnschrift Condensed',sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #160526; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Active Preset
components.css: .ds-chip { border:1px solid #160526; border-radius:0; padding:6px 8px; background:#ff5bd6; color:#160526; font:700 .72rem 'Aptos Narrow','Bahnschrift Condensed',sans-serif; } .ds-chip:hover { filter:brightness(.96); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #160526; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Privacy Stamp
components.css: .ds-privacy { display:inline-flex; gap:7px; border:1px solid #160526; padding:8px 11px; background:#fffaff; color:#160526; font:800 .76rem 'Aptos Narrow','Bahnschrift Condensed',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.08em; } .ds-privacy span { color:#8f39ff; }

narrative.overview: WattAmIUsing treats energy data like a marked-up utility timetable with a midnight palette: lively, tactile, and immediately useful. Dense evidence sits on bright lavender worksheet surfaces while deep utility ink establishes hierarchy. Electric pink marks queried periods and active decisions, with aqua carrying supporting data so the interface feels energetic without losing clarity.
keyCharacteristics: Squared utility controls and hard rules
Electric pink reserved for active windows and primary action
Dense charts balanced by plain, readable working surfaces
Flat composition with structural depth only

rules.name: The Signal Means Selection Rule
rules.body: Pink indicates an active time window, selected state, or primary action; it does not decorate passive containers.

rules.name: The Compression Rule
rules.body: Large type may be narrow and tightly set; body copy keeps normal tracking and generous line height.

rules.name: The Flat Worksheet Rule
rules.body: Permanent analysis surfaces do not float.

dos: Do join related evidence into ruled regions instead of separate floating cards.
Do keep lime meaningful by tying it to selection or action.
Do label charts with units, time context, and non-colour cues.
Do preserve usable density on desktop and deliberate stacking on mobile.
donts: Don't add rounded dashboard tiles or soft ambient shadows.
Don't use lime as an arbitrary highlight on passive copy.
Don't hide the query controls behind a modal.
Don't replace the load profile or heatmap with decorative summary graphics.
